Hi,

I have a question about the behavior of the results on the model component.

I was running a little exercise with downloaded occ from GBIF through the module and with my specified env data (as worldclim access seems to still be down). After running the model with maxent selecting all features and rm 0.5 - 5 some of the models didn't have information for Aikake criterion, others didn't have for AUC and others for OR.

I didn't see any message on the log screen or R session. Is this normal behavior? If so the lack of data is due to the values going out of the established range or something similar?

Thank you in advance, I'm just learning about wallace and found it really interesting.
